data.name: BUFFET
data.detailed_description:
WELCOME TO BUFFET! BUFFET is a party game for up to 4 players that blends classic cooking simulation with chaos. Here, you're not just trying to fulfill orders—you're trying to survive against the hungry monsters walking into your shop.

KEY FEATURES

  • Ingredients?: Steal vegetables from your neighbor’s farm. Scavenge for usable cooking materials from the trash or outside. Cook and serve the food before the customer's time runs out.

  • Monsters: Not every customer is human. If they don't like your food or if their order is late, monster customers will start attacking you. Defend yourself and your kitchen.

  • Brave/Fear: Manage your courage wisely. When your courage is high, you stand strong against monsters. When it hits rock bottom, you'll be trembling as the world darkens around you. On the flip side, being a coward gives you a speed boost so you can run away faster from monsters.

  • 4-Player Co-op: Divide and conquer with your friends. One acts as the chef, another handles serving, and someone else defends the shop from monsters with a frying pan. Coordination is everything.
